description: Resurgence large-order (bridge-equation) probe of the 4_1 Ohtsuki rungs kappa_5/kappa_6 past the exact-kappa_4 frontier: solve the leading one-instanton (S, beta) form on exact rung pairs with the C1-stabilized A, predict kappa_5/kappa_6 with A-spread bands, and invert the observed rungs for (A, beta) (audit item 6, G2+C3).
tier: structural-exact (kappa_1..kappa_4 closed forms) + numerical (leading large-order form; order-limited; hypothesis-class test, no value fit)

assertions.name: kappa_1_4_exact_match_witness
assertions.source: closed forms (11/108)sqrt3 pi, (2/27)pi^2, (1081/21870)sqrt3 pi^3, (98/729)pi^4 vs the 20-digit main-witness strings (tolerance at the reference-string precision).

assertions.name: ratio_normalization_matches_predecessor
assertions.expected: 12-digit main-witness ratio strings; A_k*r_k = k exact
assertions.source: our r_n = kappa_n/kappa_{n-1} vs the main witness ratios and the predecessor's A_k formula (qbeta_borel_pade_action.py) — SAME 1/N normalization as the C1 A.

assertions.name: synthetic_control_recovers_S_beta_kappa5
assertions.expected: beta, S, kappa_5 recovered to 1e-40 on an exact one-instanton series (A=0.6, beta=0.3, S=2), all 6 pairs
assertions.source: known-answer control of the pairwise solver — exact arithmetic, so full working precision applies.

assertions.name: consecutive_closed_form_matches_findroot
assertions.source: beta = A*r - m (analytic, consecutive pair) vs the loggamma root-finder on the real rungs at A_mean.

assertions.name: beta_equals_alpha_convention
assertions.expected: kappa_{n+1}/kappa_n = (n+alpha)/A for the expansion of (1-zeta/A)^(-alpha) — the large-order beta IS the C1 branch exponent alpha

assertions.name: pairwise_S_from_both_rungs_consistent
assertions.source: S computed from rung m and rung n of each pair must agree (construction identity of the 2-parameter solve).

assertions.name: inverse_reproduces_r5_r6
assertions.source: (A,beta) from the (4,5,6) triple must reproduce the input ratios r_5, r_6 exactly (algebraic inversion identity).

assertions.name: entropy_budget_arithmetic_spot_check
assertions.source: PR #1805 entropy rule, identical machinery to qbeta_qsqrt3_borel_pslq_probe.py.

parameters.large_order_form: kappa_n ~ (S/pi)*Gamma(n+beta)/A^(n+beta) (leading; a_1 subleading REPORTED as diagnostic, never fitted)
parameters.normalization: A in the 1/N variable (same as C1 and the predecessor ratio formula; /2pi for 2pi/N)
parameters.beta_alpha_convention: beta (large-order) = alpha (C1 Borel branch exponent); binomial-expansion identity, asserted
parameters.kill_criterion: predicted kappa_5 outside the A-spread band for EVERY rung pair => NEGATIVE scope-(a); no parameter tuning
parameters.pslq_gate: >= 12 forward-pinned stable digits of kappa_5 (PR #1805 entropy budget, C2 machinery)

pslq.gate: forward-pinned stable digits 1 (band rel width 0.0177, frontier pair (3,4)) vs required 12
pslq.reason: the leading large-order form pins only ~1 stable digits of kappa_5 (A-spread band, frontier pair) — far below the 12-digit gate; admissible PSLQ height at that budget is 0 < floor 10. Even the 14 witness digits fall ~2.9 digits short of the ~16.9 needed at the height-growth-projected kappa_5 height ~4428675 (heights 108 -> 21870 on the odd sqrt3 line) — the same entropy wall that produced the #3571-class kappa_6 false positive. Refusing to over-ask.

result.verdict: G2+C3 LARGE-ORDER BRIDGE TEST (scope-(a), leading one-instanton form, 1/N normalization): CONSISTENT (not derived): the frontier pair (3,4) — the most asymptotic exact pair — predicts kappa_5 in [83.75939404, 85.25815938] (obs 84.6421656 INSIDE, miss at A_mean -0.001295) and kappa_6 in [658.3319968, 689.6284737] (obs 676.94667 INSIDE). Pairs containing kappa_1 miss low — the O(1/n) transient the leading form omits, matching the implied a_1 ~ 0.0084. (a) (S, beta) does NOT fully stabilize across rung pairs at n <= 4 (beta spans [-0.1335, 0.385]) but the kappa_1-free pairs cluster and the frontier (3,4) gives beta = 0.24019. INVERSE: fixing observed kappa_5/kappa_6 implies A = 0.6519179 (INSIDE the C1 range [0.633771, 0.68334]) and beta = 0.21387 vs C1 alpha 0.2457 (same object: beta = alpha, proved by the binomial-expansion identity; consecutive triples (3,4,5)->(4,5,6) drift only dA ~ 0.0013, dbeta ~ 0.0086). An exact-arithmetic kappa_5 candidate still requires ~17 trusted digits at the height-projected Q(sqrt3)*pi^5 line (have 14; the large-order form pins only ~1) — PSLQ gate NOT met, PSLQ skipped with logged budget; the route remains the bridge-equation arithmetic (Ecalle Delta_omega f = A_omega df/dz, Garoufalidis-Gu-Marino Stokes data) or a higher-precision extraction. No fit wired anywhere; no c_k value; no tier change.
